title: Decompress .bz2 overwriting existing files
summary: Force bzip2 to decompress a file even if the original file already exists. This overwrites the existing file.

steps.explain: Use the -f flag to force decompression, overwriting any existing file with the same name.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the .bz2 file to decompress

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for overwriting. Restore from backup if available.

warnings: This will overwrite existing files with the same name without asking.
